messages:
Sam: Heads-up — saw quota graph on /org/42's dashboard show combined tokens after quick org switch. Repro steps below.
Ava: omg good catch, can you paste repro?
Sam: Steps:
1) open org A dashboard
2) quickly cmd+k -> switch to org B
3) observe 'tokens used' gauge briefly shows A+B
Logs:
```
GET /api/internal/metrics?range=30m
Headers:
x-org-id: 42
x-user-id: u123
cache-key: metrics:org:42:30m
```
But response includes org 41 metrics in payload. Dump: `{ "org_id": 41, "tokens": 12000 }`
Luca: that's likely our metric aggregation cache not keyed by workspace during fast switch. Might be race in prefetch middleware.
Nina: also saw a console telemetry entry with wrong org. telemetry-bot says: `telemetry:org_mismatch` once.
Sam: repro attached, I'll add HAR and timestamp. pinging @oncall and @eng-sre
Maya: quick workaround: invalidate prefetch cache on route change. Patch idea:
```
if (req.headers['x-org-id'] !== cache.meta.org) cache.invalidate(req.path)
```
Ava: That'll help but might cause extra DB hits. Consider a short TTL (1s) or per-request version tag.
Luca: Proposed fix: include per-request nonce in cache key: `${org}:${sessionId}:${bucket}` and safe-guard in metrics collector to verify org in payload.
oncall: I've scheduled a rollback if this spikes. Can someone open a bug with repro and attach traces?
Sam: done -> GH #6421
telemetry-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-88
Nina: Adding to next rollback window: we'll push hotfix with TTL and validation. :thumbsup:
Ava: Thanks all — if someone can own the hotfix + postmortem, cc me.
Sam: I'll own hotfix. ETA 2h.
